visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a brightly lit convenience store, a young man with short black hair and a striped blue shirt stands holding several snacks and a bottle of water. He gestures enthusiastically with his right hand while looking directly at the camera, his facial expression animated. Shelves stocked with colorful merchandise create a busy, urban background. (2) The scene shifts as the man presents a specific package of "Butter Toast" to the lens. He points toward the 7-Eleven logo on a lanyard, indicating the location. The camera captures close-up details of the bread's packaging and the man's expressive mouth as he speaks excitedly about the item. (3) The man hands his selected snacks to a clerk wearing a green and white striped uniform at the checkout counter. The setting transitions to the preparation area, featuring a small black oven. A slice of bread is visible through the glass door of the toaster, turning golden brown under the heating elements. (4) After the bread is removed from the oven, the clerk uses large metal scissors to cut the hot toast into smaller squares within a plastic tray. The man watches closely as condensed milk is drizzled in a criss-cross pattern over the surface, followed by a sprinkle of white sugar from a shaker. (5) The final product is shown in a close-up: glistening toasted squares on a tray with a wooden stick. The man takes a bite, his eyes widening with delight and surprise at the taste. He then shares a piece with a friend, whose reaction confirms the snack's quality in a brightly lit food court.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a rapid pace. The tone is animated and friendly, set against a background of upbeat, mid-tempo pop music featuring prominent synthesizer melodies and a steady electronic drum beat. No visible distortion is present in the recording. (2) A series of incidental sounds are captured, including the faint rustling of plastic snack bags and the metallic sound of items being placed on a counter. The speaker's pitch varies dynamically to express excitement, while the BGM remains a constant, rhythmic presence that complements the vocal delivery's intensity. (3) A distinct "ding" sound effect, likely added in post-production, punctuates the narration. The background ambiance of a retail environment is audible but muffled, while the primary speaker continues to articulate clearly with a humorous inflection. The music maintains a major-mode, positive atmosphere throughout this section. (4) The clerk is heard saying "Thank you" in a calm, brief vocal segment. This is followed by the low, continuous hum of an oven and the sharp, percussive sound of metal scissors cutting through crisp bread. A cartoonish "wow" sound effect is layered over the crunching sounds to emphasize the visual. (5) High-arousal vocal exclamations occur as the man tastes the food, characterized by rising intonation and increased volume. The sound of a crisp crunch is prominent during the bite. The BGM swells slightly in the mix, and additional laughter from a second male voice is briefly heard in the background.
